items.event_title: Microsoft and NVIDIA unveil an AI laptop designed to run agentic workloads locally
items.news_summary: Microsoft is unveiling a Windows laptop powered by NVIDIA chips that is intended to run advanced AI-agent workloads such as coding locally rather than relying entirely on cloud data centers.
items.investor_materiality: High: expands NVIDIA into a PC segment dominated by Intel and AMD and could shift part of AI inference from costly cloud infrastructure toward edge devices.
items.selection_reason: Fresh same-day product/platform catalyst spanning Windows, NVIDIA silicon, AI agents and cloud economics.
source_references: Reuters 2026-10-07: Microsoft, Nvidia CEOs to unveil new AI laptop at San Francisco event
items.youtube_query: Microsoft Nvidia AI laptop Surface Laptop Ultra RTX Spark October 2026
items.video_angle: 微软和NVIDIA为什么突然把AI从云端搬回电脑？下一轮AI硬件战争可能回到PC。

items.event_title: Marvell raises long-term revenue targets on custom AI-chip and networking demand
items.news_summary: Marvell raised its fiscal-2028 revenue outlook to about $20 billion and laid out much larger fiscal-2031 targets as hyperscalers increase spending on custom AI accelerators and high-speed interconnect.
items.investor_materiality: Very high: strengthens the custom-silicon thesis and provides a direct competitive read-through for Broadcom and NVIDIA as hyperscalers build proprietary AI chips.
items.selection_reason: Large quantified long-term guidance change with immediate stock reaction and direct AI-infrastructure relevance.
source_references: Reuters 2026-10-06: Marvell raises 2028 revenue forecast on strong AI data center demand
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting from company investor-day guidance; high quality.
items.youtube_query: Marvell 2028 revenue forecast custom AI chips Broadcom October 2026
items.video_angle: Marvell突然把长期目标拉高：AI芯片市场正在从GPU扩散到定制ASIC和高速互联。

items.event_title: NVIDIA-backed Lambda targets up to $4 billion raise before planned IPO
items.news_summary: Lambda is seeking up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO; reported backlog rose from $15 billion in June to $50 billion in September.
items.investor_materiality: High: another major financing test for the GPU-heavy neocloud model and a read-through for NVIDIA demand, AI infrastructure leverage and CoreWeave/Nebius valuations.
items.selection_reason: Large fresh financing round plus unusually rapid backlog growth in a capital-intensive AI infrastructure segment.
source_references: Reuters 2026-10-06 citing WSJ: Nvidia-backed Lambda targets $4 billion raise ahead of planned IPO
Wall Street Journal 2026-10-07: AI-Computing Startup Lambda Is Raising $4 Billion
items.source_quality_note: Reuters plus WSJ reporting; high quality, with financing details attributed to people/documents cited by WSJ.
items.youtube_query: Lambda $4 billion funding $50 billion backlog Nvidia IPO 2027
items.video_angle: 一家GPU云公司为什么敢融资40亿美元？Lambda的500亿美元 backlog 到底说明AI需求有多疯狂。

items.event_title: Blackstone-backed AirTrunk adds $1 billion to Japan AI data-center campus
items.news_summary: AirTrunk is investing another $1 billion in its 300-plus-MW Inzai hyperscale campus to deploy liquid cooling and support large-scale AI workloads.
items.investor_materiality: High infrastructure read-through: highlights Japan's role as an Asian AI-compute hub and continued spending on power-dense liquid-cooled capacity.
items.selection_reason: Fresh same-day, quantified AI data-center capex with clear Blackstone and Japan infrastructure linkage.
source_references: Reuters 2026-10-07: Blackstone-backed AirTrunk to invest $1 billion in Japan data centre campus
items.youtube_query: AirTrunk Blackstone Japan $1 billion AI data center Inzai October 2026
items.video_angle: 为什么AI数据中心开始往日本跑？Blackstone旗下AirTrunk再砸10亿美元扩容。

items.event_title: Tesla gains German backing as it pushes for broader European FSD approval
items.news_summary: Germany signaled support for faster European approval of Tesla's supervised driver-assistance system while an EU-wide decision remains contested and subject to safety and regulatory scrutiny.
items.investor_materiality: High for Tesla's autonomy narrative in Europe: broader approval could expand paid software deployment, but regulatory and safety disputes remain material.
items.selection_reason: Fresh regulatory catalyst affecting a major part of Tesla's software/autonomy valuation thesis.
source_references: Reuters 2026-10-07: Musk welcomes German backing for Tesla driver assistance tech as group chases EU approval
Reuters 2026-10-07 investigation on Tesla EU FSD lobbying
items.source_quality_note: Same-day Reuters reporting and investigation; high quality. Safety claims remain contested and are not treated as established fact.
items.youtube_query: Tesla FSD Europe Germany EU approval October 2026
items.video_angle: Tesla FSD离欧洲全面放行还有多远？德国开始支持，但真正的监管争议还没结束。

items.event_title: Micron Taiwan union secures strike authorization amid compensation dispute
items.news_summary: Workers at Micron's Taoyuan operation in Taiwan reportedly voted overwhelmingly to authorize a potential strike amid a compensation dispute, adding operational uncertainty to an already tight memory market.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high: Micron's Taiwan footprint is important to memory supply, so labor disruption risk matters when AI-driven DRAM/HBM availability is already constrained.
items.selection_reason: Fresh supply-side risk attached to one of the market's most important AI-memory beneficiaries.
source_references: Barron's 2026-10-07: Micron Stock Falls as Memory Plant Threat Adds to Chip-Sector Gloom
items.source_quality_note: Same-day financial press reporting; useful but lower source quality than a company filing or Reuters, so operational impact remains unconfirmed.

items.video_angle: 内存已经这么缺了，Micron台湾工厂又出现罢工风险：HBM和DRAM会不会更紧？
